paper_title: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways

claims.statement: PaLM 540B was trained on 6144 TPU v4 chips using the Pathways system, achieving a model FLOPs utilization of 46.2% and a hardware FLOPs utilization of 57.8%.

evidence.quote: With Pathways, we trained a 540B parameter language model on 6144 TPU v4 chips at eﬃciency levels that could not be reached before for models of this scale.

we describe how we were able to scale pipeline-free training of PaLM 540B to 6144 chips across two TPU v4 Pods while achieving very high eﬃciency of 46.2% in model FLOPs utilization (observed throughput relative to theoretical max throughput) and 57.8% in hardware FLOPs utilization.
